_comment: Port allocation scheme per ADR 0014. Internal ports are Docker overlay only (no host mapping). Where a host mapping is needed for an internal service it MUST be loopback-only (127.0.0.1:<port>:<port>) — never a bare <port>:<port> mapping, which publishes to all host interfaces. Only the explicitly listed host ports are published to all interfaces: is-fleet (29999) and is-tempo (29996). Retired ports are never reassigned — see ADR 0014 §4. The gateway_host_ports range and agent role blocks (base/orch/veri/work) were retired 2026-08-21 with the openclaw agent layer.

_notes.is-tempo host (29996): Published to host for operational access via port 29996. Internal port 21015. Port assignments documented in ADR-0042 § Port assignments.
_notes.is-fleet host (29999): Published to host for operational access via port 29999. Internal port 21002.
_notes.agent-credential-broker (21016): Internal overlay only, never host-published. Broker listens on the agent-broker-net overlay; workers reach it by service name. Registered 2026-08-14 with ADR 0047 swarm wave (plan swarmcredentials-1).
_notes.llm-audit-proxy (21018): Internal overlay only, never host-published. One instance is deployed per fixed inference upstream; it writes redacted per-request telemetry to Tasks/Logs/LLM.
